card.name: Caution when combining with other drugs
card.fires_on: The word "when" right after "caution is advised" or "use caution" in drug interaction sections, just before the drug is named as given together with another. Also weaker on linking words like "to" or a comma before a comparison or reason.

modes.label: Caution when co-administered
modes.description: "when" following a caution phrase, leading into a drug being given with another drug.
modes.example: and the potential for serotonin syndrome, caution is advised<< when>> desvenlafaxine is co

modes.label: Other linking words in interactions
modes.description: "to" in an exposure comparison or a comma after a reason clause such as protein binding.
modes.example: resulted in a 77% increase in exposure to simvastatin compared<< to>> simvastatin alone.

card.plain: It fires on the small word that introduces the drug being taken together with another in an interaction warning.
